title: Elevator System
summary: N elevators, hall and in-car requests, dispatching and states.
description: Design the control software for a building with N elevators. People call an elevator from a floor (hall call, with an up or down button) or choose a destination inside the car. The system decides which elevator serves each hall call.

requirements.text: The building has N elevators serving floors 0..M.
Hall calls (floor + direction) and in-car requests (destination floor) are both supported.
Each elevator tracks its direction (up, down, idle) and door state (open, closed).
A dispatcher picks the best elevator for each hall call.
An elevator can be put into maintenance mode and then receives no new requests.
Doors never open while the elevator is moving.

constraints: Requests arrive concurrently from many floors.
Assume a simulated clock; no real hardware.
Capacity/weight limits are out of scope unless you choose to add them.

changeRequest.title: Peak-hour dispatch
changeRequest.text: Switch the dispatch strategy by time of day: zone-based dispatch during the morning peak (each elevator serves a block of floors), nearest-car the rest of the day.
